# Zechariah Chapter 1 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ZEC_001_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**1:1** In-the-eighth [ba-shemini] month [ba-chodesh], in-the-second year of-Daryavesh, the-word of-YHWH came to Zekharyah [Zechariah] son of-Berekhyah [Berechiah] son of-Iddo [Iddo] the-prophet, saying:

**1:3** "And-say [ve'amarta] to-them, 'Thus says YHWH of-Hosts: Return [shuvu] to-me,' declares YHWH of-Hosts, 'and-I-will-return [ve'ashuv] to-you,' says YHWH of-Hosts."

**1:8** I-saw [ra'iti] in-the-night [ha-lailah], and-behold [ve-hinneh], a-man [ish] riding [rokhev] on a-red [adom] horse [sus], and-he [was] standing [omed] among the-myrtle-trees [ha-hadassim] which [were] in-the-hollow [ba-metsulah]; and-behind-him [acharav] [were] horses [susim] red [adummim], sorrel [seruqqim], and-white [u-levanim].

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Zechariah 1 — part of the Book of the Twelve (Minor Prophets).
